figurative_meaning_bn: অনটনের চাপে সৎপথে থাকা যায় না
figurative_meaning_en: Under the pressure of hardship, one cannot remain on the path of righteousness
similar_in_english: Desperate times call for desperate measures
example_sentences_in_bangla: অভাবে স্বভাব নষ্ট হয়ে গেছে, তাই সে এখন অনৈতিক কাজ করছে।
গ্রামের অনেক লোক অভাবে স্বভাব নষ্ট করে চুরির পথে নামে।
example_sentences_in_english: His character has been spoiled in want, so now he is resorting to unethical acts.
Many villagers turn to theft as their nature gets corrupted by poverty.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali views on how economic deprivation affects personal integrity.
